4738.title: The other game
4738.text: You can't count on winning just by imposing your own rules on your opponent, if your opposition never have agreed to the suggested rules, and it is just you who is playing by them, it is a definite loss.

4743.title: System
4743.text:
Blind, merciless, absolute.
People stay within the system even it is absurd and meaningless in the most extreme way possible. Often system places the border right next to the spot where host of opportunities can be seen, just one step away.

4744.title: Fisherman
4744.text: When it's time to move on and it's meaningless to stay, often we continue to hope against hope. These expectations can't be justified, as long as we're standing still and watching our fantasies, unable to move further.

4750.title: Lost
4750.text:
When the world has fallen
and you are still holding to its ruined walls
and you are scared
and you are lost.

Just release.

4751.title: Sea Foam
4751.text:
I have seafoam in my veins, I understand the language of waves.

© Jean Cocteau

4747.title: Сome as you are
4747.text:
Don't be shy, your true nature is always the most beautiful

This very sensitive portrait was taken during our trip to Berlin ;)

4754.title: Ligo
4754.text: Searching for the fern, be careful, 'cause you may not like what you'll discover. Happy summer solstice!

4736.title: Blind
4736.text: It doesn't really matter what surrounds you, if you can't see any of it. If you keep your eyes closed for just a bit too long, it might be too late to open them up already.

4755.title: Fallen sky
4755.text: Thrilling moment of touching your wildest dreams, that unexpectedly came true.

4756.title: Fly away
4756.text:
Sometimes it is nice to just give in, let the force pick you up and carry in its direction.
Leaves you with time to think and observe

4739.title: Observing the force and the strength.

4767.title: Anorexia dreams
4767.text: Every girl has an anorexia of some kind, you should closely look after yourself, not to fall beaten by it

4740.title: Airfree
4740.text:
Can you see
there is something
in the Sweden sea

4741.title: Becoming a sunset
4741.text: If you believe and trying hard enough, wings of your dream make everything possible

4753.title: Emptiness
4753.text: Sometimes it feels like you are really dead empty inside, because someone just hurt you one step to far. Brace yourself, keep your inner self

4746.title: Road fork
4746.text: Often what is white and tidy on the outside is completely black inside. And when it gets to choose, there are no options in reality.

4776.title: Totem
4776.text: Sometimes it takes a mask, to express what is on the inside.

4763.title: Oak girl
4763.text: Every once in awhile try to be in the moment, to be present and conscious of your surroundings, feel the whisper inside and submerge into the world around you. Carpe diem.

4764.title: Happy Easter!
4764.text: Sometimes you have to brake an egg to make a photo :)

4737.title: Sleeping Beauty
4737.text: When you choose a weapon against your enemy, make sure it's not her passion.

4765.title: Bulletproof
4765.text:
Sometimes it is important to find a balance, to let your inner power out, despite what happens in the outer world.

Freeze the moment, take as long as necessary to evaluate surroundings, then react!

4768.title: Birds
4768.text: Once you let yourself dream, your dreams may actually come true.

4748.title: Plastic
4748.text: When you are trying to merge with surroundings, but all your attempts are faked and plastic, even something different, exclusive and alive in your hands won't resist or survive

4758.title: The Wall
4758.text: You can be brave and bold, when there is The Wall behind you, when there is something to rely on

4749.title: Step to the nowhere
4749.text: Living with your eyes wide shut, eventually you will run out of path to follow, though unable to see it, you will make the step

4807.title: Bright Lights
4807.text: If you'll look up from time to time, instead of staring at your feet, it can bring you some unforgettable experience :)

4745.title: Standing in line
4745.text: Standing, waiting and starring. Everything around you just fades away, only last line of defense remains, but it won't hold its own for long. In the end only you against the wild force, one on one, face to face.

4772.title: Denial
4772.text: First you note it, then you're trying to connive at it and when it's too difficult you just turn yourself back.

4752.title: The Rise
4752.text:
Once there was only dark, and it will all return to darkness one day.
Each of us is on his own battle keeping the light within him bright. Some days it requires all of your strenght just to keep the darkness
that lies within you away.

4770.title: Get disconnected
4770.text: Gadgets are awesome, but if you'll turn them off just for an hour, you'll see a colorful bright world around you

4775.title: Not so easy to wake up a supergirl

4762.title: Moments of choice
4762.text: You were left behind before, and people still might leave you in the darkest of moments. Those moments are the best time to think through you next step.

4759.title: Triangles
4759.text: The most important is to find where you fit in. When it's done all you need is to accumulate and transform

4771.title: First Day of September
4771.text:
Not all knowledges are similar. And for some of them, there is different way to study.
Happy first school day for all who involved! Be laborious, but still naughty :)

4760.title: New Year. Happy for someone, not so much for others

4769.title: Circle of life
4769.text: The beginning and the end, circle of life may happen in one moment or last for years. Seize the day, cause you don't know when your term expires.

4761.title: Lost
4761.text: ...so small, so pure. In the hidden river of the stream of life

4766.title: Face your Fears
4766.text: We want to turn our back to the fears we face and run. But you can't outrun your fears, you can't hide from them, the only way of overcoming fear is standing up against them!

4778.title: Happy New Year Everyone!
4778.text: Especially those who are within the bounds of traditions, rules and superstitions. Have the courage for passion, growth and keep on trying to follow your dreams.
